Class StaticBodyGenerator

java.lang.Object
io.micronaut.python.processing.staticcompile.StaticBodyGenerator
public final class StaticBodyGenerator extends Object
Turns the Ir of a compiled body into SourceGen statements inside a stub method. The generator is total: every node has a rendering, and only the lowering that produced the IR can refuse a body.
Since:
5.3.0
Author:
Graeme Rocher

    • generateShared

      public static io.micronaut.sourcegen.model.StatementDef generateShared(Ir.CompiledBody body, List<io.micronaut.sourcegen.model.VariableDef.MethodParameter> methodParameters, StaticBodyGenerator.SelfAccess self, boolean trace)
      Generates the statements of the shared entry of a compiled body: the body as it is, except that a list, set or dict parameter is not copied on entry. A compiled sibling calls it (an Ir.InvokeSibling dispatched shared) with its own collections, which the callee updates as Python's callee updates the caller's; the stub's Java method, which Java callers call, copies them as the bridge would and calls this entry, see generateEntry(Ir.CompiledBody, List, Function).
      Parameters:
      body - The body
      methodParameters - The parameters of the shared entry, in order
      self - How the properties of self are reached
      trace - Whether the body counts its entries in PythonStatic.entries()
      Returns:
      The statements
